title: Karl Frisch
description: Frisch highlights on his school board bio that he is the “first openly LGBTQIA+ person elected to local office in Virginia’s largest county.”
body:
# Karl Frisch

# Providence District Representative

![](/media/uploads/2026/03/Frisch-profile.jpg)

- Highlights on his **[school board bio](https://www.fcps.edu/frisch)** that he is the “first openly LGBTQIA+ person elected to local office in Virginia’s largest county.”
- Chose to be **[sworn into office](https://fairfaxschoolsmonitor.com/karl-frischs-sacred-texts/)** using graphic sexually explicit books including “Gender Queer” that depicts someone in the act of oral sex.
- Frisch **[supports](https://fairfaxschoolsmonitor.com/karl-frischs-sacred-texts/)** locker room usage and competing in sports based on gender identity, not biological sex.
- Made **[a motion](https://go.boarddocs.com/vsba/fairfax/Board.nsf/goto?open&id=DEYHGY488102)** and voted in support of declaring March 31 to be Transgender Day of Visibility in the district.
